meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, why was my son's mark changed without anyone calling me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He could have drafted somewhere else and pasted it in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay. Whatever happens here, nothing goes on his record and it stays quiet. Did you speak to Owen before you entered the zero?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Kids misquote from memory, Hale. Does a bad quotation make him a cheat?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. What exactly are you proposing, and will it be in writing?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
People change their argument between an outline and an essay. That's called revising.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. A private rewrite, before December 1, his record clean, and the zero replaced: I'll accept that to put this behind him, not because he did anything. In writing tonight, copied to the principal.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
He'll be there. Put the time and the room in the email tonight.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite of Owen's essay on Thursday, November 12 after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still expect the time and room in that email, and the zero gone from the gradebook. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday, November 12 after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record; she still wants it in writing tonight with the time and room, copied to the principal. That is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its dates and times and turned the screen so she could read it herself, which gave her something dated to check instead of a score.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether you spoke to Owen before entering the zero, so that point stayed open on her side.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came close when you read out the late night of October 28 with its edits just before midnight, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you had spoken to Owen before the zero went in, answer it directly in that moment, since the procedure she printed puts that step first.
